''See also: [[Winter Sage Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Min Shuei]], also known as the Winter [[Sage]] or the [[Frozen Blade|Sage of the Frozen Blade]], is a powerful martial artist and master of sword techniques. She possesses long white hair and wields a massive [[Forged]] sword, which she can use to manifest large-scale attacks such as giant white blades or freezing blizzards. Her combat abilities are deeply connected to the [[Authority|authority]] of the [[Winter Icon]], allowing her to manipulate ice and frost to slow enemies or lock down entire areas with suspended snowflakes. She is capable of high-speed flight through her control over aura, despite not being a wind artist. As a [[Sage]], she is characterized by intense emotional shifts, ranging from profound rage and fury to moments of sincere awe or weeping. She has a complex relationship with [[Yerin]], having previously served as her master and training her to manage her [[Blood Shadow]]. [[Min Shuei]] is also noted for her wisdom regarding the nature of the [[Monarchs]] and her ability to recognize illusions. In battle, she has demonstrated the capacity to fight against [[Dreadgods]] and resist mental techniques from powerful entities like the [[Silent King]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|This woman possesses long white hair and wears a halo that matches her hair color. She is often seen cloaked in a hailstorm of razor-sharp ice and stands upon a levitating sword.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|An intolerant and currently distracted teacher, the Winter [[Sage]] expresses intense fury and disgust toward the parasite inside [[Yerin]]. She acts as a guide for her pupil, motivated by the desire to see [[Yerin]] become a symbol of swordsmanship to reach the [[Sword Icon]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Winter [[Sage]] serves as a teacher and guide to her pupil, [[Yerin]]. She has also been noted to be at the side of [[Charity]] and once physically pushed the [[Blood Sage]] away from [[Yerin]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|A combatant who utilizes raw strength and sword skill rather than specific techniques, she is known for her precisely timed attacks. She also possesses the ability to stand upon a levitating sword.}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|“We will have our own accounting,” the Winter Sage said, her voice furious.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c9" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The Winter Sage had been sending her out to fight with her sword, insisting that this would help her become a “symbol” of swordsmanship and thus get closer to the Sword Icon.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c11" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|“…and we’ll have to seal that thing,” the Winter Sage spat.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c18" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The Winter Sage took a deep, relieved breath. “They should have warned us!”<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c19" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|“Congratulations,” the Winter Sage whispered.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c24" />}}
